findings.evidence: The docs-import test only reads README.md and documentation/examples.md (line 194) and only parses `import ... from 'jattac.libs.web.zest-button'` clauses; features.md, api.md, configuration.md and breaking-changes.md are not parsed, and the features-table test at lines 159-170 extracts only the first table column. Consequently an incorrect Icon, Variant, Button style, Icon side or Default behaviour cell, or a non-compiling example outside README/examples, leaves the suite green. One such example exists today: documentation/configuration.md:137 imports only `ZestButtonConfigProvider, ZestIcon` but the same snippet renders `<ZestButton>` at line 166 without importing it.
findings.description: Extend the R7 docs test to all seven pages and compare every features-table column against semanticTypeButtonConfigDefaults, and add the missing default ZestButton import to the configuration.md example. Advisory: the shipped table content currently matches the defaults and the broken named import that QA-2 reported is now guarded, so this is proof breadth, not a current requirement break.

findings.evidence: The test named "each of the 28 new names is accepted by the SemanticType type" only annotates a literal array as SemanticType[] and asserts its length. No test augments `CustomZestSemanticTypes`; if `| keyof CustomZestSemanticTypes` were removed from the union at UI/ZestButton.tsx:20, every test would still compile and pass, so the R1 acceptance "and still accepts the names added through CustomZestSemanticTypes" remains unproven.
findings.description: Add a small declaration fixture that augments CustomZestSemanticTypes with `publish: 'publish'` and assigns `'publish'` to SemanticType, mirroring the docs recipe at examples.md:161-171. Advisory (carried over from round 1): the union still ends in `keyof CustomZestSemanticTypes` today, so the behaviour is present but unguarded.

verifications.evidence: UI/zestIcons.tsx:161 now guards the lookup with `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ZEST_ICON_ELEMENTS, name)` and returns null otherwise. __tests__/ZestIcon.test.tsx:68-80 asserts getZestIconElement returns null and <ZestIcon> renders no svg/text for __proto__, constructor, toString, hasOwnProperty and valueOf. The suite passes: 18 suites, 224 tests.
